study type: Experimental study with human tissue samples
cohort: The study utilized trophoblast cells (likely cultured) for experimental manipulation and analyzed placentas from patients with preeclampsia.
finding: LASP2 was significantly up-regulated in placentas from patients with preeclampsia, and its overexpression suppressed trophoblast cell proliferation, migration, and invasion by inactivating the Wnt/b-catenin signaling pathway, suggesting LASP2 contributes to PE pathogenesis.
